turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How's life treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hanging in there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm taking the airport train with two massive suitcases. Any tips?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Board at the first carriage or the last one. They're usually quieter and closer to the luggage space.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got a small bonus at work and I don't want to just blow it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice! You could put it toward your credit card balance or start an emergency fund. Which matters more to you right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, let's continue after lunch.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sounds good.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How's the no caffeine thing going?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Day four. My head is pounding and I hate everyone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Including me?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Especially you. You're drinking a latte right in front of me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you want me to make you a herbal tea?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Mint. And put a lot of honey in it, please.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Coming up. It gets easier after a week, apparently.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It better.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Finished, Moshi. Tell me the rest.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Have you thought about the bonus, paying off the card or building a cushion?
